name: article-index-resource-hub
purpose: Every resource of a hub as one ruled list, with a headline and one searchable dropdown per facet (content type, category, industry) on one row that wraps when it runs out of room. Each resource is a row — its cover on the left, and on the right its overline, headline and a two-line deck centred in the row; the row is one link named by its headline, and from `lg` up a read cue rises into its end on hover or keyboard focus. The facets combine; a load-more button closes the list. It is a page section — the site places it from a `{ _id: 'article-index-resource-hub', props }` entry and binds `props` straight onto it — and it composes `section-module`, `frame-box`, `select`, `input` and `button`; the facet selections and each dropdown's option search are local state.
useWhen: For a resource hub that mixes content types (e-books, posts, comparisons, stories), filtered by facet.
avoidWhen: For the blog's list filtered by a category picker and a search field, with bylines → use `article-index-blog`.
For the success-story library with a card grid → use `story-library`.
related: article-index-blog` — the sibling listing with a category picker and a search field.
story-library` — the card-grid library with search and facets.
bestPractices: Give every item a `facets` entry per facet `key` it can be filtered by; an item without one never matches a selection on that facet.
Keep each facet's `options` to values some item carries.

props.name: anchor
props.doc: In-page id set on the band so a `#hash` link can scroll to it.

props.name: title
props.doc: Headline beside the dropdowns, rendered as the band's `h2`.

props.name: items
props.doc: The resources, in order; each is `{ key, href, image, meta, title, description, facets? }`.

props.name: facets
props.doc: The facet dropdowns, in order; each is `{ key, label, allLabel, options }`.

props.name: rowLabel
props.doc: Read cue revealed at the end of a row under hover or focus.

props.name: moreLabel
props.doc: Label of the load-more button under the list; the button is omitted when empty.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.doc: Accessible name of the list of resources.

examples.name: Default
